add_sources.note: Verified on page 21 Oct 2026: ABC News (11 Jun 2026) quotes Cr Reynolds that the council is providing $200,000 a year for three years to the festival, plus in-kind support such as traffic management and access to council properties; the council also paid to waive Winter Feast entry on its final night, 21 June 2026. Confirms the third-party Instagram snippet.
Pulse Tasmania (29 Mar 2025), verified on page 21 Oct 2026: the 2025 council deal was a one-year sponsorship of $150,000 cash plus in-kind support, so the three-year deal most likely starts in 2026.

Discover Tasmania listing, verified on page 21 Oct 2026: 'Dark Mofo will return in full for 2027'. Its 'Tuesday 22 June 2027' is a tourism listing date, not an organiser date. Organiser IG bio reads 'June 2027'.
